title: Legacy UAP program rotten and breaking as insiders defect

tellings.quote: the disclosure as being this kind of recognition that the legacy program is rotten basically in more ways than one, maybe bureaucratically institutionally, maybe also morally rotten and it it may be in the process of breaking basically, right? Everyone's defecting out of it, right? That's what seems to be happening.

plain: The secret "legacy programme", the long-running effort said to hold knowledge of UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), is "rotten" and "in the process of breaking" as insiders defect from it, according to the analyst Matthew Pines. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that it may be rotten bureaucratically and "maybe also morally", and that the public push for disclosure in the 2020s is really a recognition of that. If he is right, the recent wave of whistleblowers is a sign of a hidden system coming apart.
